title: Prove strict finite-block descent and exact infimum of the projection recurrence
body:
The source projection recurrence had an exact limit but no proof that its actual block-four top ratios decrease at every finite block. This proves strict descent for all m≥4 and therefore the exact unattained infimum 439277/149175.

The proof uses the weight h(r)=1−3/2^(r+1): interior weighted rows dominate in every upper tail, while two boundary inequalities follow from 22 exact rational checks plus a summable bound for all subsequent blocks. The strict top-ratio gap is an explicit positive rational expression. Nick Petalas's PR5151 supplies the credited exact limit; Jacob Alan Sussman's PR4628 and Maximilian Lutz's PR4643 supply the unchanged recurrence and seed.

Validation: independent normalized Fraction recurrence and limit calculation; registered normal/optimized checks; source-history checks; official 11-file export; Git-free read-only normal/optimized replay; eight actual source/receipt/scientific corruptions rejected in both modes. An independent AI-assisted mathematical review checked the quantified argument. No proof-kernel or human review is claimed.

This is an arithmetic recurrence theorem. The inherited block-four hook-rank and representation premises remain explicit; no physical supplier, selected κ change, or complete multiplication theorem is asserted. Open next questions retain the unresolved hook-rank certificates.

Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; original contributor attribution and Apache-2.0 retained.
